ammonia.reason: Limited proteolysis and deamination in heat-denatured whey matrix during short 30-day maturation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism by residual flora in sheep whey.

bitter.reason: Modest hydrophobic whey peptides with salt masking and minimal casein proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, piercing, or methyl-ketone formation.

browning.reason: Moderate residual lactose with already-denatured whey protein gives limited Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: High 85-90C whey heating kills citrate-positive LAB, limiting diacetyl/acetoin synthesis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Heat inactivation of native lipase and short age limits butyric/hexanoic acid lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Particulate denatured lactalbumin network with 28% fat gives grainy, non-creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Heat-acid precipitated whey proteins lack fused rennet-casein network and fracture easily.

firmness.reason: Dry-salted, pressed and 10-day dried whey-protein matrix at 50% moisture firms body.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal Phe catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol due to heat and short age.

fruity.reason: Low free fatty acids and heat-inactivated esterases limit ethyl butanoate/hexanoate formation.

goaty.reason: Low lipolysis of caproic/caprylic acids and no goaty branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Limited Strecker degradation to 2/3-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile due to low proteolysis.

melt.reason: Heat-crosslinked beta-lactoglobulin/alpha-lactalbumin network cannot flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No surface mold and minimal linoleate oxidation to 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: Low total fat and strong whey-protein emulsification limits free oil release on heating.

smoky.reason: No cold-smoking step, so no guaiacol/syringol deposition from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Vinegar/citric acid for coagulation buffered to pH 6.1-6.9 with low lactic/acetic acid.

stretch.reason: No intact rennet-casein network at pH 6.1 to align and stretch in hot water.

sulfur_cooked.reason: 90C whey heating denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S, methional and dimethyl sulfide.

sweet.reason: Residual whey lactose/lactulose at high pH with low acidity gives mild milky sweetness.

umami.reason: Modest Glu/Asp release from whey proteolysis potentiated by 3% NaCl.
